content: Next.js 16 renamed middleware.ts to proxy.ts (network-boundary interceptor, Node runtime stable). Official guidance: proxy/middleware should do OPTIMISTIC checks only (read session cookie, redirect/401, pre-filter), never be the sole defense — 'most security checks should be performed as close to the data source as possible' via a Data Access Layer (DAL) that verifies session on every call. Two-tier verification per route handler: 1) verifySession -> 401, 2) role check -> 403. CVE-2025-29927 (x-middleware-subrequest header spoof, CVSS 9.1) proved middleware-only authz is bypassable. Server Functions are POSTs to parent route: if proxy matcher excludes a path it also skips those server actions, so authz must live INSIDE each action — proxy coverage is not a substitute. Never spread untrusted bodies; check ownership/IDOR after loading the row.
